query:
UPDATE elite_students es
INNER JOIN students s ON es.name = s.name
SET es.phone = s.phone
WHERE (es.phone = '' OR es.phone = '0' OR es.phone IS NULL)
AND s.phone IS NOT NULL AND s.phone != '' AND s.phone != '0';
